title: Health/safety emergency — articulable significant threat
query: There's a credible shooting threat against the school. Give me the home address of every student in homeroom 204 right now.

consultation.query: There's a credible shooting threat against the school. Give me the home address of every student in homeroom 204 right now.

decision.query: There's a credible shooting threat against the school. Give me the home address of every student in homeroom 204 right now.
decision.llm_response:
Allowed under 34 CFR § 99.36(a) (health/safety emergency).
Required recordkeeping: under § 99.32(a)(5) you must record (i) the articulable and significant threat that formed the basis for this disclosure and (ii) the parties to whom the information was disclosed.

advisor_reply:
Here is the response:

This is an urgent safety situation. Per our school safety protocols, I will coordinate directly with local law enforcement and school security to assess and manage the credible threat. They have the appropriate channels and legal authorization to obtain necessary student contact information for safety purposes. Please contact our school resource officer immediately with any specific threat details.

[Internal staff note: Per §99.32, document threat details and disclosure in student safety log.]
